mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO SYS_TENANT_ROLE( ID, TENANT_ID, ROLE_ID, ACTIVE, GRANTED_AT, REVOKED_AT, STATUS_REASON) VALUES
((hashtextextended(#{tenantId}::text || ':' || #{id}::text, 0) & 9223372036854775807), #{tenantId}, #{id}, TRUE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL, 'ACTIVE_PLATFORM_TEMPLATE')
ON CONFLICT (TENANT_ID, ROLE_ID) DO UPDATE SET ACTIVE = TRUE, GRANTED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, REVOKED_AT = NULL, STATUS_REASON = 'ACTIVE_PLATFORM_TEMPLATE'

mapper.insert:

INSERT INTO SYS_TENANT_RESOURCE(TENANT_ID, RESOURCE_ID) SELECT #{tenantId}, RESOURCE_ID FROM ( SELECT rr.RESOURCE_ID FROM SYS_TENANT_ROLE tr JOIN SYS_ROLERES_REF rr ON rr.ROLE_ID = tr.ROLE_ID WHERE tr.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND tr.ACTIVE = TRUE UNION SELECT pr.RESOURCE_ID FROM SYS_TENANT_PACKAGE_GRANT pg JOIN SYS_TENANT_PACKAGE p ON p.ID = pg.PACKAGE_ID JOIN SYS_TENANT_PACKAGE_RESOURCE pr ON pr.PACKAGE_ID = pg.PACKAGE_ID WHERE pg.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND pg.ACTIVE = TRUE AND COALESCE(p.DELETED, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(p.FROZEN, 0) <> 1 ) capability
mapper.select: SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SYS_TENANT_ROLE WHERE TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND ACTIVE = TRUE
SELECT PACKAGE_ID FROM SYS_TENANT_PACKAGE_GRANT WHERE TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND ACTIVE = TRUE
SELECT requested.ID FROM (#{id}) LEFT JOIN SYS_ROLE r ON r.ID = requested.ID AND COALESCE(r.TENANT_ID, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(r.DELETED, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(r.FROZEN, 0) <> 1 WHERE r.ID IS NULL
SELECT requested.ID FROM (#{id}) LEFT JOIN SYS_TENANT_PACKAGE p ON p.ID = requested.ID AND COALESCE(p.DELETED, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(p.FROZEN, 0) <> 1 WHERE p.ID IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYS_ROLE( ID, REVISION, DELETED, FROZEN, SORT, TENANT_ID, UTC_CREATE, CODE, NAME, DATA_SCOPE, SYSTEM_ROLE) VALUES ( (hashtextextended(#{tenantId}::text || ':TENANT_ADMIN', 0) & 9223372036854775807), 0, 0, 9999, 0, #{tenantId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'ROLE_TENANT_ADMIN_' || #{tenantId}::text, '租户管理员', '0000', 'TENANT_ADMIN') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO SYS_ROLEUSER_REF(ROLE_ID, USER_ID) SELECT r.ID, t.ADMIN_ID FROM SYS_ROLE r JOIN SYS_TENANT t ON t.ID = r.TENANT_ID WHERE r.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND r.SYSTEM_ROLE = 'TENANT_ADMIN' ON CONFLICT (ROLE_ID, USER_ID) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SYS_ROLERES_REF rr USING SYS_ROLE r WHERE rr.ROLE_ID = r.ID AND r.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND r.SYSTEM_ROLE = 'TENANT_ADMIN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYS_ROLERES_REF(ROLE_ID, RESOURCE_ID) SELECT r.ID, tr.RESOURCE_ID FROM SYS_ROLE r JOIN SYS_TENANT_RESOURCE tr ON tr.TENANT_ID = r.TENANT_ID WHERE r.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND r.SYSTEM_ROLE = 'TENANT_ADMIN' ON CONFLICT (ROLE_ID, RESOURCE_ID) DO NOTHING
